title: Ansel and the Cipher
author: Wren Delacroix
blurb: Lior Nystrom, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
